        }
    }

    w[0] = 1;

            w[i] = (w[i] + current * (i + 1)) % mod;
            ll part1 = (dp[j - 1] * w[i - j] + w[j - 1] * dp[i - j]) % mod;
            ll part2 = (i - j) * (i - j + 1) / 2 + j * (j - 1) / 2;
            ll contribution = (C[i - 1][j - 1] * part1) % mod * (i + 1) % mod;
            contribution = (contribution + current * part2) % mod;
            dp[i] = (dp[i] + contribution) % mod;
        }
    }

            for (int j = 1; j <= min(i - 1, k); ++j) {
                int pi = i - j - 1;
                int pk = k - j;
                ll cw = C[k][j];
                w2[i][k] = (w2[i][k] + cw * w2[pi][pk] % mod * w[j]) % mod;
                ll temp1 = cw * w2[pi][pk] % mod * dp[j] % mod;
                ll temp2 = cw * dp2[pi][pk] % mod * w[j] % mod;
                dp2[i][k] = (dp2[i][k] + temp1 + temp2) % mod;
            }
        }
        for (int j = 0; j <= m; ++j) {
            dp2[i][j] = (dp2[i][j] + dp2[i - 1][j]) % mod;
            w2[i][j] = (w2[i][j] + w2[i - 1][j]) % mod;
        }
    }

    cout << dp2[n + 1][m] << '\n';
